acceptanceCriteria: A test interrupts cleanup after the WORKTREE_REMOVE write and shows takeover finishes or rolls back the removal with a typed outcome.
Removed-worktree records within one assignment are bounded or compacted, with a test showing repeated cleanup does not grow them.
body: Residual from PR #1531 (V1-0826, ATR-V0-296..298, seal 9fc574e07). (1) If `program cleanup` or a reassign is interrupted after the WORKTREE_REMOVE write, takeover refuses to resume because that phase is not a safe takeover phase, so the program stays stuck until manual repair. (2) Records of removed worktrees accumulate within a single assignment rather than being compacted. Found by lane local-fixes-1021x, 2026-10-22. Suspected from code reading; reproduce first.
title: Tasks program cleanup: an interrupted WORKTREE_REMOVE cannot be taken over, and removed-worktree records pile up within one assignment
